subject: Re: Kickoff: principal-subspace aux tasks for retrieval
body:
Anders,

Resourcing locked:

- Staffing: Wei 60% (method), Kaia 40% (theory/evals), Nikhil 60% and Gustavo 50% (scaling + integration), all through early August.
- Compute: iteration happens on titan-a100 best-effort. For the big one: We hold the vulcan-h100 reservation for the week of 2026-06-29 - 256 accelerators - which is when the full-scale subspace pretraining sweep runs. I scheduled it deliberately after the 6/22-6/24 Vulcan maintenance window so we get a clean week.
- Evalline: Kaia is registering the retrieval eval suite with Tomas's team; 2-week lead time, already filed.

Only open risk on resourcing is corpus access for the embedding matrices - Corpus v2 migration shouldn't affect us since we read snapshots, but Gustavo is confirming with Jun's team.

Alina
